Significant experience overseeing office renovations, tenant improvements, infrastructure projects, and capital projects. Experience working with project managers and managing multiple concurrent projects. Strong knowledge of Facilities operations, building systems, preventive maintenance, workplace standards, budgeting, procurement, contracts, and vendor management. Proven ability to operate independently, make decisions, resolve issues, and manage competing priorities across multiple locations. Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability and willingness to travel frequently. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is not simply a traditional Facilities Manager. This individual should be a strong regional operator who can independently manage a large, distributed portfolio through project managers, vendors, contractors, landlords, and service providers. The successful candidate should be comfortable moving between strategic leadership and hands-on problem solving and must be capable of building structure and accountability in a region that does not have a large dedicated Facilities organization.
